pages.text: “Vines entwine, a refreshing floral sweetness clears away toxins and restores clarity.”$(br2)Honeysuckle Tea is a purifying herbal drink made from dried honeysuckle flowers and sugar. The tea has a pale yellow color with a light floral fragrance. Drinking it removes poison effects, allowing travelers to regain their composure in times of crisis.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Honeysuckle Tea, $(br)boil dried honeysuckle flowers with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed when afflicted by poison, providing a quick detoxification effect to restore well-being.

Upon drinking Honeysuckle Tea, travelers will have poison effects removed, restoring their health.$(br)This is a detoxifying and refreshing tea, ideal for combating various toxins.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
